text:
IncBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Mistral tenant (dedicated-vpc-pool-3) experiencing sustained tail latency > 4s and queue depth spike. Page sent to oncall.
Tia: received. pulling dashboard now. which tenant config are we targeting? any recent deploys? @Sam FYI
Sam: no deploys in the last hour. I can see request_rate jump from 120 -> 850 r/s on that tenant, bursty short requests causing tiny batches and high per-token overhead.
Jae: looking at scheduler logs, their queue is consistently hitting backpressure; their scheduler instance is pinned to pool-3, and `min_batch_tokens` seems default. suspect we need to adjust `max_batch_tokens` and reduce queue concurrency.
Nora: customer (Mistral) reported degraded service at 09:14 UTC via support ticket 89421. They're on a dedicated capacity contract and are sensitive to tail latency.
Tia: ok plan: quick mitigation to reduce tail: 1) lower `max_concurrent_requests` for that tenant to slow intake 2) bump `max_batch_tokens` to allow larger coalesced batches 3) enable gentle shedding to non-critical routes. Sam, can you make the change on pool-3? Mike, can you prepare a rollback? Jae, gather logs & metric snapshots.
Sam: on it. Pushing ephemeral override to the tenant routing config now. command:
```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant mistral --pool dedicated-vpc-pool-3 \
  --set scheduler.max_concurrent_requests=40 \
  --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=4096 \
  --set scheduler.soft_drop=true
```
Sam: applied. waiting for scheduler to pick up new config (rolling over 2 nodes).
IncBot: Config change detected for tenant mistral by Sam at 4123456796. Change id: cfg-7b3.
Jae: seeing batch sizes increase from mean 12 tokens -> 260 tokens on pool-3, latency for median requests remains ~120ms but tail 99.9 dropped from ~5600ms -> ~1800ms. Improvement but still above SLO.
Mike: starting a gradual throttle patch to admission controller to favor larger batches and cap worker concurrency. Deploying to 1 node as canary.
Tia: update customer success so they don't page again. Nora, can you post a short note to Mistral that we're actively mitigating and expect visible improvement within 10-15m? Keep wording non-technical.
Nora: message queued to Mistral: "We've identified an operational load pattern in your dedicated pool causing high tail latency. Our engineers are applying temporary tuning and expect improved responsiveness within 10-20 minutes. We'll follow up with details and a permanent plan." Sent.
Sam: canary node sees better smoothing. tail 99.9 now ~750ms. Rolling change to remaining nodes.
Jae: grabbing logs for change window 4123456796-4123456820 and saving to /shared/incidents/mistral/4123456789.log. snippet from scheduler:
```
[09:15:12] scheduler: tenant=mistral queue_len=174 max_batch_tokens=1024 -> 4096
[09:16:03] scheduler: selected_batch_size=236 tokens batch_time_ms=28
[09:18:40] admission: concurrent_workers=48 -> 40
```
Tia: good. next steps: postmortem will need root cause: why request_rate spiked and why default knobs didn't adapt. Also propose long-term: auto-scale pool for dedicated tenants, add adaptive `max_batch_tokens` based on per-tenant token distribution, and a safer slow-path fallback to a compatible smaller model to preserve latency.
Mike: note: `soft_drop=true` allowed us to drop low-priority / health-check style requests. We should document what routes are considered low-priority for Mistral. I recommend a config key `route_priority` that teams can set.
Sam: all nodes rolled, metrics look stable. request_rate dropped to 210 r/s and tail latency 99.9 ~320ms. closing page in 10 if stable.
Jae: final metric before handoff: 99.9 latency 310ms, avg batch size 188 tokens, queue depth returned to baseline. logs uploaded.
Tia: handing off to SRE for follow-up and postmortem. Add action items: (1) schedule dedicated capacity audit with Mistral (2) add runbook entry for 'tenant soft-throttle' procedure (3) evaluate adaptive batching experiment.
Sam: acknowledging handoff. I'll convert cfg-7b3 to a revertible rollout and tag in repo.
Nora: following up with customer: sent summary and ETA for postmortem.
IncBot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED - Mistral tail latency mitigated. Duration: ~18m. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.
Tia: thanks team. I'll create the postmortem draft and ping for reviewers."
